width_mm.conditions: Front-to-back depth of the top-entry header: the drawing dimensions the moulded body as 2.9 mm plus a 0.7 mm solder-tab extension in front of it (0.7 + 2.9). Both figures are called out on the top-entry side view; the sum is the footprint depth.

source.section: Header -- Top entry type, side view

height_mm.conditions: Height above the PCB surface: the top-entry side view dimensions the body as 4.25 mm and a 0.05 mm standoff between the PCB and the underside of the body (4.25 + 0.05). NOTE: the side-entry variant SM02B-SRSS-TB is only 2.9 mm tall (with a 4.95 mm depth); if lid clearance is the binding constraint, that is the variant to consider.
